newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BNDESPar to sell Brazil's Coelba shrs Wed.
newsitem.headline: BNDESPar to sell Brazil's Coelba shrs Wed.

text.p: Brazil's BNDES Participacoes (BNDESPar), the investment arm of the National Development Bank (BNDES), said it would auction a 6.88 percent voting stake in Bahia state power utility Coelba Wednesday.
A total of 670 million voting shares belonging to BNDESPar will be sold for 82.82 reais per lot of 1,000 shares at an auction on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange, it said in a published statement.
The shares are the result of the conversion of debentures issued by the company in July last year, the statement said.
Local and foreign banks, including Banco Omega, Unibanco, Primus and ING Barings, will broker the sale, the statement added.
Controlled by Bahia state government, Coelba is expected to be privatized this year. ((-- Fatima Cristina, Rio de Janeiro newsroom 5521 5074151))
